output: Thanks for raising this. You're right that per-seat pricing grows as your team grows, and doubling headcount over two years would make that visible by the second renewal. Not every person on your team needs the same level of access, though. Our lower-cost contributor and viewer seat types are built for occasional users, and multi-year terms can cap the annual increase. Here is the pricing example for a company with mostly contributor seats: [PLACEHOLDER] pricing example: three-year cost for a company with mostly contributor seats. I'd be glad to send a three-year cost model at your expected user mix, with the renewal cap options side by side, so you can compare how each path would look as your headcount grows.
